workItem: P8.58 Graph Delta Approval Workbench Boundary Plan
problemStatement: Approval stages cannot rely on static cards/tables alone. Reviewers must inspect graph structure, graph deltas, code diffs, changed-node diffs, changed-edge diffs, and the evidence/authority records behind each change before answering approval prompts.

targetSurface.purpose: make approval evidence inspectable before the user/coordinator grants the next execution or release-related gate

buildBorrowIntegrateDecision.reason: Cytoscape.js is strong for graph exploration, data-driven node/edge styling, selection events, pan/zoom, layouts, and static local HTML packaging.
buildBorrowIntegrateDecision.fallback: D3 or React Flow may be reconsidered if Cytoscape.js cannot satisfy delta highlighting or inspector requirements.

graph.nodes: stable selectable node records with id, kind, label, status, source refs, evidence refs, authority refs, history refs, delta refs, graphDiffRef, and codeDiffRefs
graph.edges: stable selectable edge records with id, kind, source, target, status, provenance/confidence, evidence refs, authority refs, history refs, delta refs, and graphDiffRef

diffs.codeDiffs: file path, before range, after range, change kind, diff hunks, affected graph ids, evidence refs, authority refs, blocker if missing
diffs.graphNodeDiffs: element id, before payload, after payload, changed fields, ref changes, affected code diff refs, evidence refs, authority refs, blocker if missing
diffs.graphEdgeDiffs: element id, before payload, after payload, changed fields, ref changes, affected code diff refs, evidence refs, authority refs, blocker if missing

validationRequirements: projection has graph nodes and edges
every visible node has a selection payload
every visible edge has a selection payload
changed nodes have graph node diff refs
changed edges have graph edge diff refs
code-affecting nodes or delta steps have code diff refs
missing required diff refs produce blocker records
delta steps point only to existing nodes/edges/diffs
HTML contains local graph visualization runtime only
HTML has node inspector, edge inspector, delta list, code diff panel, graph diff panel, and evidence/authority panel markers

negative probes reject missing selection payloads, missing changed-node diff, missing changed-edge diff, missing code diff, edge endpoint mismatch, network script, mutation controls, and false authority flags
graphifyGradeBenchmarkTasks: find a node by search and inspect its incoming/outgoing edges
select an edge and inspect relation/source/target/provenance
select a delta step and see affected nodes and edges highlighted
select a changed code node and see the source diff
select a changed existing node and see its graph before/after diff
select a changed existing edge and see its graph before/after diff
verify evidence and authority records attached to the selected graph element
confirm productization and execution blockers are visible

recommendedImplementationSlices.name: Graph Delta Approval Workbench Projection Schema
recommendedImplementationSlices.goal: Emit a deterministic projection JSON with graph nodes/edges, delta states, code diffs, graph element diffs, inspectors, and blockers.

recommendedImplementationSlices.name: Static Graph Delta Approval Workbench Prototype
recommendedImplementationSlices.goal: Render the projection as static local HTML with interactive graph, selection inspector, delta highlighting, code diff, graph diff, and no network dependency.

recommendedImplementationSlices.name: Graph Delta Workbench Negative Probes
recommendedImplementationSlices.goal: Prove missing inspector payloads, missing diffs, broken endpoints, network scripts, UI mutation controls, and false authority flags fail deterministically.

recommendedImplementationSlices.name: Graphify-Grade Usability Dry Run
recommendedImplementationSlices.goal: Run the required graph exploration tasks against the new workbench and compare against the raw JSON/card-table path.
